name: dexi
description: Connect Claude to your Dexi notes: shared memory across assistants, search and capture knowledge mid-session, and spaced-repetition reviews on your due cards

recall.title: Memory recall at session start
recall.description: Tell Claude at the start of each session that Dexi is your shared memory for the project, so it checks for prior decisions and saves new ones

checkpoints.title: Save checkpoints
checkpoints.description: After a long run of tool calls with nothing saved to Dexi, ask Claude once to save any decision worth keeping

checkpoint_every.title: Checkpoint interval
checkpoint_every.description: Tool calls between save checkpoints (when checkpoints are on)
